title: Certifications
subtitle: 「認證／資格／正式資歷／證書」，必須分清『資格狀態』、『證明文件』和『專業認可制度』。
description: 「認證／資格／正式資歷／證書」，必須分清『資格狀態』、『證明文件』和『專業認可制度』。

words.meaning: 正式資歷；正式資格證明
words.example: Applicants must provide formal credentials in first aid and safety training.
words.exampleZh: 申請人必須提供急救和安全培訓的正式資歷證明。

exercises.original: Applicants must provide relevant certifications before appointment.
exercises.zh: 申請人獲任命前必須提供相關正式資歷證明。
exercises.upgrade: Applicants must provide relevant formal credentials before appointment.

options.explanation: provide + before appointment 表示需要可核實的正式資格證明，最貼近 certifications。
只是學習過程，未必有正式資格結果。
可以支持申請，但不等於正式認證。
會員身份未必證明專業能力。
獎項不一定和職位標準相關。
只說出席，沒有正式資格證明。

exercises.original: The employer verifies each candidate's certifications.
exercises.zh: 僱主會核實每名候選人的正式資歷。
exercises.upgrade: The employer verifies each candidate's formal credentials.

options.explanation: 也合理，但 credentials 更直接對應『可被核實的正式證明』。
verify credentials 是非常自然的招聘搭配。
記錄培訓不等於已獲認證。
工作經驗不能直接當 certification。
會員資料不是認證本身。

exercises.original: She submitted copies of all her certifications with the application.
exercises.zh: 她隨申請提交所有正式資格證明副本。
exercises.upgrade: She submitted copies of all her formal credentials with the application.

options.explanation: submitted copies 表示可文件化、可驗證的資格證明。
經驗本身不能『提交副本』成為 certification。
licence 是其中一類，但只說 licences 會縮窄原意。

words.example: The position requires relevant qualifications in project management.
words.exampleZh: 這個職位要求具備項目管理相關資歷。

exercises.original: The role requires several recognised certifications.
exercises.zh: 這個職位要求多項獲認可資格。
exercises.upgrade: The role requires several recognised qualifications.

options.explanation: role requires + recognised 表示招聘所需的正式資格集合。
只證明出席，通常不足以滿足正式資格要求。
原句明確要求 certifications，而不只是經驗。
會員身份未必等於資格。
參加過培訓不代表取得資格。

exercises.original: She has certifications in accounting and risk management.
exercises.zh: 她具備會計和風險管理方面的資格。
exercises.upgrade: She has qualifications in accounting and risk management.

options.explanation: has qualifications in + field 是自然廣義改寫。
只有特定受規管工作才需要牌照，過窄。

exercises.original: Candidates with additional certifications may be preferred.
exercises.zh: 具備額外資格的候選人可能獲優先考慮。
exercises.upgrade: Candidates with additional qualifications may be preferred.

options.explanation: 也可能影響招聘，但原句重點是正式資格。
additional qualifications 是招聘語境的自然上位詞。

words.example: Participants receive certificates after completing the course.
words.exampleZh: 參加者完成課程後會獲發證書。

exercises.original: Participants receive certifications after completing the course.
exercises.zh: 參加者完成課程後獲發證書。
exercises.upgrade: Participants receive certificates after completing the course.

options.explanation: receive + after completing the course 指實際獲發的證書文件。
一般短期 course 不會自動授予學位。
完成課程不一定獲政府／監管牌照。
課程完成不等於加入組織。

exercises.original: The system stores digital copies of employees' certifications.
exercises.zh: 系統儲存員工各項證書的電子副本。
exercises.upgrade: The system stores digital copies of employees' certificates.

options.explanation: 可廣義理解，但 digital copies 明確指實體／電子文件，因此 certificates 更準。
證書可以掃描或以數碼副本儲存。

exercises.original: Please upload your certifications to the portal.
exercises.zh: 請把你的證書上載到平台。
exercises.upgrade: Please upload your certificates to the portal.

options.explanation: upload 需要具體文件，certificate 是最直接。
不能作為可上載證書的同義詞。
能力本身無法直接上載。

words.meaning: 專業資歷；專業資格證明
words.example: The employer checks candidates' professional credentials before appointment.
words.exampleZh: 僱主在任命前會核實候選人的專業資歷。

exercises.original: The consultant's certifications were checked before the contract was signed.
exercises.zh: 簽訂合約前核實了顧問的專業資歷。
exercises.upgrade: The consultant's professional credentials were checked before the contract was signed.

options.explanation: consultant + checked before contract 是典型專業資格核實語境。
會員卡不一定證明專業資格。

exercises.original: The hospital reviews staff certifications every year.
exercises.zh: 醫院每年檢視員工的專業資歷。
exercises.upgrade: The hospital reviews staff professional credentials every year.

options.explanation: 醫院可能同時核實牌照和其他認證，only 會過窄。
涵蓋專業資格、認證等正式資料。
不等於每年需更新的資格。

exercises.original: Clients often ask to see a trainer's certifications.
exercises.zh: 客戶常要求查看培訓導師的專業資歷。
exercises.upgrade: Clients often ask to see a trainer's professional credentials.

options.explanation: ask to see 表示需要正式、可展示的專業證明。
可能增加可信度，但不是 certification 的直接替代。
不能完全替代正式資格。
受訓紀錄未必代表認證。
會員身份不一定等於專業能力。

words.example: She completed several professional qualifications in finance.
words.exampleZh: 她完成了多項金融專業資格。

exercises.original: She is working toward certifications in finance and compliance.
exercises.zh: 她正在取得金融和合規方面的專業資格。
exercises.upgrade: She is working toward professional qualifications in finance and compliance.

options.explanation: working toward + professional fields 是非常自然的資格取得語境。
加入組織不等於通過資格要求。
不能說 work toward experience 作同一意思。

exercises.original: The company pays for employees to gain certifications.
exercises.zh: 公司資助員工取得專業資格。
exercises.upgrade: The company pays for employees to gain professional qualifications.

options.explanation: 不能通常透過公司資助『取得』成為專業資格。
gain professional qualifications 是標準搭配。

exercises.original: Some certifications are required for promotion to senior roles.
exercises.zh: 某些專業資格是晉升高級職位的必要條件。
exercises.upgrade: Some professional qualifications are required for promotion to senior roles.

options.explanation: promotion requirement 常以正式專業資格表述。
不一定是晉升硬性要求。
完成培訓不等於取得資格。

words.meaning: 認可資格；認證資格；認可狀態
words.example: The training centre holds several industry accreditations.
words.exampleZh: 該培訓中心持有多項業界認可資格。

exercises.original: The training centre holds several recognised certifications from industry bodies.
exercises.zh: 該培訓中心持有多項業界機構認可資格。
exercises.upgrade: The training centre holds several industry accreditations.

options.explanation: training centre 是機構，industry bodies 對機構／課程的正式認可最適合 accreditation。
centre 本身不是以個人證書方式被認可。
培訓中心不一定持有學位。
牌照是合法營運授權，和質素認可不同。
不一定代表正式標準認可。

exercises.original: The programme has certifications from two professional bodies.
exercises.zh: 這個課程獲兩個專業機構正式認可。
exercises.upgrade: The programme has accreditations from two professional bodies.

options.explanation: 可以是文件，但 programme + professional bodies 更常用 accreditation 表示課程獲認可。
認可對象是 programme，最符合制度性用法。

exercises.original: The college maintains several external certifications for its vocational courses.
exercises.zh: 學院為職業課程維持多項外部認可資格。
exercises.upgrade: The college maintains several external accreditations for its vocational courses.

options.explanation: 通常發給個人或營運者，不是 vocational courses 的認可。
external bodies 對課程質素／標準的認可最自然。

words.meaning: 獲認可的資歷；認可資格證明
words.example: The programme leads to recognised credentials in cybersecurity.
words.exampleZh: 該課程可取得網絡安全方面獲認可的資歷。

exercises.original: The course leads to certifications accepted by major employers.
exercises.zh: 課程可取得主要僱主認可的資歷。
exercises.upgrade: The course leads to recognised credentials accepted by major employers.

options.explanation: accepted by major employers 明確強調認受性。
課程本身不能直接授予工作經驗。

exercises.original: Students value certifications that are recognised internationally.
exercises.zh: 學生重視獲國際認可的資歷。
exercises.upgrade: Students value internationally recognised credentials.

options.explanation: internationally recognised 是最核心線索。

exercises.original: The employer accepts only certifications recognised by approved bodies.
exercises.zh: 僱主只接受獲認可機構承認的資歷。
exercises.upgrade: The employer accepts only recognised credentials from approved bodies.

options.explanation: approved bodies + accepted by employer 正是 credential recognition。

words.meaning: 業界認證；行業資格認證
words.example: The course prepares students for several industry certifications.
words.exampleZh: 這個課程為學生準備多項業界認證。

exercises.original: The cybersecurity course prepares learners for several certifications used by employers.
exercises.zh: 網絡安全課程為學員準備多項僱主常用的業界認證。
exercises.upgrade: The cybersecurity course prepares learners for several industry certifications.

options.explanation: cybersecurity + employer-recognised technical credentials 是典型業界認證。
網安工作通常不是法定牌照語境。

exercises.original: IT workers often add new certifications as technologies change.
exercises.zh: 資訊科技從業員常隨技術轉變取得新的業界認證。
exercises.upgrade: IT workers often add new industry certifications as technologies change.

options.explanation: 上過課不等於取得正式認證。
IT 技術更新時取得新 certification 是典型情境。
不會頻繁隨技術變化而新增。

exercises.original: The employer prefers candidates with current cloud certifications.
exercises.zh: 僱主偏好持有最新雲端業界認證的候選人。
exercises.upgrade: The employer prefers candidates with current cloud industry certifications.

options.explanation: 一般沒有這種直接對應，而且 degree 範圍不同。
current cloud certification 是業界技能認證的典型例子。

words.example: Employees can earn professional certifications through the company scheme.
words.exampleZh: 員工可透過公司計劃取得專業認證。

exercises.original: Employees can earn certifications in project management.
exercises.zh: 員工可以取得項目管理專業認證。
exercises.upgrade: Employees can earn professional certifications in project management.

options.explanation: earn + project management 是典型職業認證語境。
不可用 earn certification 的同一方式。
項目管理 certification 不等於學位。

exercises.original: The company reimburses fees for approved certifications.
exercises.zh: 公司會發還認可專業認證的費用。
exercises.upgrade: The company reimburses fees for approved professional certifications.

options.explanation: 公司可能發還會費，但原句指 certifications。
reimbursement of certification fees 是常見職場福利。

exercises.original: Some professional certifications must be renewed every three years.
exercises.zh: 某些專業認證每三年必須續期。
exercises.upgrade: Some professional certifications must be renewed every three years.

options.explanation: renewal cycle 是許多專業認證的典型特徵。
學位通常不需每三年續期。
會員可續會，但不是 certification 本身。

words.meaning: 認證資格；已獲認證的身份
words.example: Technicians must maintain certified status through regular training.
words.exampleZh: 技術員必須透過定期培訓維持認證資格。

exercises.original: Technicians must keep their certifications current through regular training.
exercises.zh: 技術員必須透過定期培訓維持認證資格。
exercises.upgrade: Technicians must maintain certified status through regular training.

options.explanation: maintain + current certification 指持續保持已認證身份。
只出席培訓不足以概括 certification status。

exercises.original: The organisation checks whether staff certifications are still valid.
exercises.zh: 機構會檢查員工的認證資格是否仍然有效。
exercises.upgrade: The organisation checks whether staff still have valid certified status.

options.explanation: licence 是法定許可，只適用部分職業。
valid certification 對應仍然保持認證身份。
會員有效不代表認證有效。

exercises.original: Regular assessment is required to retain the certification.
exercises.zh: 需要定期評核以維持認證資格。
exercises.upgrade: Regular assessment is required to retain certified status.

options.explanation: 評核可能與會員有關，但 certification 更直接是 certified status。
retain + regular assessment 非常自然。
只出席不足以保證 status。

words.example: Everyone who finishes the workshop receives a certificate of completion.
words.exampleZh: 完成工作坊的所有人都會獲發修業證書。

exercises.original: Everyone receives a certification simply for finishing the workshop.
exercises.zh: 所有完成工作坊的人都會獲發修業證書。
exercises.upgrade: Everyone receives a certificate of completion simply for finishing the workshop.

options.explanation: simply for finishing 表示未必有能力考核，因此 professional certification 過強。
只證明完成工作坊，最精準。

exercises.original: The short course gives a certification of completion but no professional status.
exercises.zh: 短期課程會發修業證書，但不授予專業資格。
exercises.upgrade: The short course gives a certificate of completion but no professional status.

options.explanation: 會暗示達到業界能力標準，和 no professional status 不符。
明顯與 no professional status 衝突。

exercises.original: Participants who attend all sessions receive a certification showing they completed the programme.
exercises.zh: 出席所有環節的參加者會獲發證明完成課程的證書。
exercises.upgrade: Participants who attend all sessions receive a certificate of completion.

options.explanation: 不自然，也不一定是資格文件。
attend all sessions + completed programme 是典型完成證書。
原句沒有考核能力標準。

words.example: The college offers diplomas and professional certifications in digital media.
words.exampleZh: 學院提供數碼媒體文憑和專業認證。

exercises.original: The college offers both diplomas and shorter certifications.
exercises.zh: 學院同時提供文憑和較短期的認證課程。
exercises.upgrade: The college offers both diplomas and shorter certifications.

options.explanation: college + longer formal study award 和 shorter certifications 作對比非常自然。

exercises.original: Some learners progress from short certifications to full diploma programmes.
exercises.zh: 部分學員由短期認證進階至完整文憑課程。
exercises.upgrade: Some learners progress from short certifications to full diploma programmes.

options.explanation: full diploma programme 和 degree 不是同一層級。
和 short certifications 對比出完整教育課程。

exercises.original: The institute awards diplomas after longer programmes and certifications after shorter specialist courses.
exercises.zh: 學院在較長課程後頒發文憑，在短期專門課程後頒發認證。
exercises.upgrade: The institute awards diplomas after longer programmes and certifications after shorter specialist courses.

options.explanation: longer programmes 與短期 certifications 的制度差異最清楚。
雖可作一般名詞，但不精準指出教育文憑。

words.meaning: 專業稱號；專業資格稱號
words.example: The qualification allows successful candidates to use a professional designation.
words.exampleZh: 該資格讓合格人士使用正式專業稱號。

exercises.original: Successful candidates receive a certification allowing them to use an official professional title.
exercises.zh: 合格人士取得認證後可使用正式專業稱號。
exercises.upgrade: Successful candidates earn a professional designation allowing them to use an official title.

options.explanation: use an official professional title 是 designation 的直接線索。
會員卡不一定授予專業稱號。
學位不等於這個專業稱號。

exercises.original: The certification lets members add letters after their names.
exercises.zh: 該認證讓會員可在姓名後加上專業稱號縮寫。
exercises.upgrade: The professional designation lets members add letters after their names.

options.explanation: post-nominal letters 是專業稱號的典型特徵。
牌照本身通常不是姓名後的資格稱號。
單純會員身份未必可使用稱號。

exercises.original: After completing the certification process, she gained the recognised title.
exercises.zh: 完成認證程序後，她取得獲認可的專業稱號。
exercises.upgrade: After completing the process, she gained a recognised professional designation.

options.explanation: recognised title + certification process 明確指正式專業稱號。
不一定會產生專業稱號。

words.meaning: 數碼資歷；電子資格證明
words.example: Learners can add their digital credentials to their online profiles.
words.exampleZh: 學員可以把數碼資歷加入網上個人檔案。

exercises.original: Learners can add their certifications to an online profile as verifiable records.
exercises.zh: 學員可把認證以可驗證紀錄形式加入網上個人檔案。
exercises.upgrade: Learners can add their digital credentials to an online profile.

options.explanation: online profile + verifiable records 是數碼資歷的典型用途。
與 online profile / verifiable digital record 不符。
不可直接作可驗證資格紀錄。

exercises.original: The platform issues certifications that employers can verify online.
exercises.zh: 平台發出可供僱主網上核實的數碼資格證明。
exercises.upgrade: The platform issues digital credentials that employers can verify online.

options.explanation: issued digitally + employers verify online 完全吻合。

exercises.original: The university is moving some certifications to secure online records.
exercises.zh: 大學正把部分認證轉為安全的網上資格紀錄。
exercises.upgrade: The university is moving some certifications to secure digital credentials.

options.explanation: secure online records 是數碼資格證明的直接描述。

falseSynonyms.zh: 牌照不等於 certification licence（英式名詞）通常由政府或監管機構授權某人合法從事某活動；certification 多數證明能力或符合標準。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A licence grants legal permission; a certification usually confirms competence or compliance.

falseSynonyms.zh: 學位不等於 certification degree 是大學授予的學術資格，通常涵蓋完整學位課程；certification 往往更短、更專門。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A degree is an academic award; a certification is usually narrower and skill- or standard-focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: 會員身份不等於 certification 加入專業組織不一定表示已通過專業認證。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Membership may accompany credentials, but being a member does not automatically mean being certified.

falseSynonyms.zh: 獎項不等於 certification award 可以是比賽、表現或成就獎勵；certification 是依標準授予的資格證明。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An award recognises achievement; a certification verifies a standard or competence.

falseSynonyms.zh: 培訓本身不等於 certification training 是學習過程；certification 是完成要求或通過評核後取得的資格／認證。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Training can lead to certification, but it is not the certification itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 經驗不等於 certification 工作經驗可以支持資格，但沒有正式認證時，不能稱 certification。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Experience demonstrates practice; certification provides formal verification.

falseSynonyms.zh: 出席證明不等於專業認證 出席證明只證明參加過活動，未必有考核，也不證明能力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Attendance confirms presence; certification usually requires meeting defined requirements.

falseSynonyms.zh: 認可與 certification 的對象常不同 accreditation 很多時針對機構、課程或服務；certification 更常針對個人、產品或技能。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Accreditation and certification overlap, but they often apply to different subjects and processes.
